title: Unconditioned generative models lack mode control
description: In an unconditioned generative model, there is no control over which modes of the data are generated; conditioning on additional information is proposed as a way to direct the data generation process.
canonical_description: unconditioned generative models provide no control over generated data modes

evidence.anchor: no control on modes of the data being generated
evidence.quote: In an unconditioned generative model, there is no control on modes of the data being generated.
